title: Renal CT Benchmark: public five-class renal-tumor CT subtyping

creators.name: Liu, Qiang
creators.affiliation: Academy of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing Institute of Petrochemical Technology

description:
This archive is version 1.0.0 of the Renal CT Benchmark code and frozen fold file. It trains on public UCSF-RMaC portal-venous CT and evaluates on public RCC-AID and KiTS23. The ladder is a size logistic baseline, frozen radiomics, 3D ResNet runs, and linear probes of three CT foundation models. Images, masks, and foundation-model weights are not included; obtain them from the sources named in the README.

The code is MIT. Cohort licences remain with the public sources (UCSF-RMaC CC BY 4.0, RCC-AID annotations CC BY 4.0, KiTS23 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).

Cite this archive as Liu Q. Renal CT Benchmark: public five-class renal-tumor CT subtyping. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23668646. Cite the accompanying manuscript for the scientific findings.
